{{Quote|I am impressed! You know not only the language of the Yuuzhan Vong, but the ways of the warrior. What is your name?''"<br />"''Jariah Syn. Served once with a Yuuzhan Vong warrior named Chonyo. He taught me a lot.|Fionah Ti and Jariah Syn|<ref name="Legacy 44" />}}
'''Chonyo''' was a [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Warrior caste|warrior]]<ref name="Legacy 44" /> who crewed aboard the ''[[Crimson Axe]]'' at some point before the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[137 ABY]].<ref name="Legacy 17" /> The ''Crimson Axe'' was a [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] [[Captain/Legends|captained]] by [[Rav]], a notorious [[Feeorin/Legends|Feeorin]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] whose opportunistic crew helped him attack ships and settlements throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="LECG" /> While serving aboard the vessel, Chonyo taught the young [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jariah Syn]]<ref name="Legacy 17" /> to manipulate Yuuzhan Vong [[biot]]echnology and to operate illegal Yuuzhan Vong weaponry<ref name="LECG" /> such as [[Nang hul|thud bugs]]<ref name="Legacy 17" /> and [[amphistaff]]s,<ref name="Legacy 44" /> both of which Syn could easily handle by 137 ABY.<ref name="Legacy 44" /><ref name="Legacy 17" /> Chonyo was fluent in the [[Yuuzhan Vong (language)|Yuuzhan Vong]], a [[Language/Legends|tongue]] that he also taught to Syn.<ref name="Legacy 44" />

==Behind the scenes==
Created by [[John Ostrander]] and [[Jan Duursema]], Chonyo was first mentioned, albeit unidentified, in [[2007]] in the [[Legacy (2006) 17|seventeenth issue]] of the [[Star Wars comic books|comic series]] ''[[Star Wars: Legacy]]''.<ref name="Legacy 17" /> He was later identified in [[2010]] in the [[Legacy (2006) 44|forty-fourth issue]] of the series.<ref name="Legacy 44" />
